youtube_description: Join former Disney star Laura Marano on her gratitude journey as she reflects on her career and shares her perspectives on the power of gratitude. This interview will give you an inside look at the life of a successful actor and how gratitude has played a role in her journey. Get ready to be inspired and encouraged to embrace gratitude in your own life!
